inductive Scan [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    [DecidableEq (Value Symbol Guard)]
    (budget : Nat) (unconstrained reaches : Value Symbol Guard → Bool)
    (values : List (Value Symbol Guard)) :
    Constraints → Checked width → Memo → Option Class → Constraints → Checked width → Memo → Prop where
  | nil : Scan budget unconstrained reaches values [] state memo none [] state memo
  | selected
      (primary : EndpointStatefulGateTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained reaches values paths
        before.native.machine.heap false heap)
      (rest : Scan budget unconstrained reaches values classes (advanceHeap before heap)
        memo outcome selected after saved) :
      Scan budget unconstrained reaches values (paths :: classes) before memo outcome (paths :: selected) after saved
  | skipped
      (primary : EndpointStatefulGateTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained reaches values paths
        before.native.machine.heap true heap)
      (secondary : SourceCurrentSecondaryTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained values paths heap true anchor)
      (rest : Scan budget unconstrained reaches values classes
        (advanceHeap (advanceHeap before heap) anchor) memo outcome selected after saved) :
      Scan budget unconstrained reaches values (paths :: classes) before memo outcome selected after saved
  | continued
      (primary : EndpointStatefulGateTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained reaches values paths
        before.native.machine.heap true heap)
      (secondary : SourceCurrentSecondaryTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained values paths heap false anchor)
      (seeded : SourceCurrentAllocatedSeededQuery.Seeded values
        (paths.map (List.map Int.ofNat)) (advanceHeap (advanceHeap before heap) anchor) query middle)
      (decision : SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call budget memo query (physical middle) false later savedMemo)
      (rest : Scan budget unconstrained reaches values classes (advancePhysical middle later)
        savedMemo outcome selected after saved) :
      Scan budget unconstrained reaches values (paths :: classes) before memo outcome selected after saved
  | stopped
      (primary : EndpointStatefulGateTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained reaches values paths
        before.native.machine.heap true heap)
      (secondary : SourceCurrentSecondaryTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained values paths heap false anchor)
      (seeded : SourceCurrentAllocatedSeededQuery.Seeded values
        (paths.map (List.map Int.ofNat)) (advanceHeap (advanceHeap before heap) anchor) query middle)
      (decision : SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call budget memo query (physical middle) true later saved) :
      Scan budget unconstrained reaches values (paths :: classes) before memo (some paths) []
        (advancePhysical middle later) saved

/-- Constructor-only effects retain every checked invariant at the same native tables. -/

def Ranges [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    [DecidableEq (Value Symbol Guard)]
    (budget : Nat) (unconstrained reaches : Value Symbol Guard → Bool)
    (values : List (Value Symbol Guard)) : Constraints → Checked width → Memo → Prop
  | [], _, _ => True
  | paths :: classes, before, memo =>
      (∀ heap, EndpointStatefulGateTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained reaches values paths
        before.native.machine.heap false heap →
        Ranges budget unconstrained reaches values classes (advanceHeap before heap) memo) ∧
      (∀ heap, EndpointStatefulGateTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained reaches values paths
        before.native.machine.heap true heap →
        ∀ anchor, SourceCurrentSecondaryTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained values paths heap true anchor →
        Ranges budget unconstrained reaches values classes (advanceHeap (advanceHeap before heap) anchor) memo) ∧
      (∀ heap, EndpointStatefulGateTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained reaches values paths
        before.native.machine.heap true heap →
        ∀ anchor, SourceCurrentSecondaryTrace.ClassTrace unconstrained values paths heap false anchor →
        SourceCurrentAllocatedSeededQuery.SeededRanges values (paths.map (List.map Int.ofNat))
          (advanceHeap (advanceHeap before heap) anchor) ∧
        ∀ query middle, SourceCurrentAllocatedSeededQuery.Seeded values (paths.map (List.map Int.ofNat))
          (advanceHeap (advanceHeap before heap) anchor) query middle →
          ∀ later saved, SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call budget memo query (physical middle) false later saved →
            Ranges budget unconstrained reaches values classes (advancePhysical middle later) saved)

noncomputable def scan (g s p h n budget : Nat) (values : List (Value Symbol Guard)) :
    Constraints → Checked width → Memo → Outcome Result width
  | [], before, memo => .done (none, []) before memo
  | paths :: classes, before, memo =>
      (gate true g values paths before memo).bind fun primary middle current =>
        if primary then
          (gate false s values paths middle current).bind fun secondary later saved =>
            if secondary then scan g s p h n budget values classes later saved
            else (query p h n values paths later saved).bind fun value checked fourth =>
              (decision p h budget paths value checked fourth).bind fun answer after final =>
                if answer then .done (some paths, []) after final
                else scan g s p h n budget values classes after final
        else (scan g s p h n budget values classes middle current).select paths

  | [], profile => projectionProfile seed count profile
  | path :: rest, profile => step (foldProfile count seed rest (projectionProfile path count profile))

def SeededReserved (bits count : Nat) : List (List Int) → Profile → Prop
  | [], _ => True
  | seed :: rest, profile => Reserved bits count seed rest profile

/-- Every complete fold retains its original numeric profile. -/

def foldFuel (count : Nat) (seed : List Int) : List (List Int) → Profile → Nat
  | [], profile => projectionFuel seed count profile
  | path :: rest, profile => max (projectionFuel path count profile)
      (max (foldFuel count seed rest (projectionProfile path count profile))
        (queryFuel (foldProfile count seed rest (projectionProfile path count profile))))
